body:
Apply shared Clean Look surfaces and semantic accent tokens to MyDay and the Front desk/Consultation homes. The shared Spaces stylesheet also affects its existing consumers. Both Vue scripts match current main exactly, preserving role projections, masking, links, handlers and existing workflow behavior. No backend, permission, migration or assertion change is included.

The normal main refresh preserves all three originally reviewed file blobs byte-for-byte. Independent review confirms the semantic CSS scope, original source parity and current-main ancestry. This remains the existing home presentation foundation, not a complete demo-content replacement.

Validation on the refreshed candidate: all 2,205 frontend tests pass with no skips, full TypeScript and production build pass, and scoped ESLint/Prettier/diff checks pass. The original reviewed 32 synthetic before/after light/dark captures remain historical evidence for the unchanged source, with empty-queue and role-fallback limitations recorded; no new current-main browser matrix or full backend suite is claimed. Fresh exact-head CI and then-current-main containment remain merge gates.
